title: Provider file
description: A provider file of authz-agent, version 1 (authz-agent-ADR-0104). The agent reads every provider file in /etc/authz/providers at start.

$schema.description: The address of a JSON Schema for this file, which an editor reads to validate and complete it. The agent accepts any string here.

providers.description: The trusted providers, keyed by name. The name decides which checks a token of the provider gets (ADR-0104 R22).

identityProvider.description: The identity provider of the platform. Its tokens are identity-provider tokens (ADR-0104 R22).

type.description: realms: one issuer per realm, given by issuerTemplate. single: one issuer, given by issuer. The type decides which other members the provider accepts.

identityProviderRealms.description: The members of the provider identity-provider of the type realms.

issuerTemplate.description: The iss of the tokens, with {realm} in place of the realm: the path segment of iss that differs between the issuers of this provider, which Keycloak calls a realm (ADR-0104 R19).

jwksUri.description: The address of the keys of a realm, with {realm} in place of its name, over http or https (ADR-0104 R23).

readinessRealms.description: Realms whose keys must load before the agent reports ready, each named as it stands in place of {realm} in iss after percent-decoding (ADR-0104 R12, R13, R25).

identityProviderSingle.description: The members of the provider identity-provider of the type single.

jwksUri.description: The address of the keys, over http or https (ADR-0104 R23).

kubernetes.description: The API server of the cluster. Its tokens are Kubernetes tokens (ADR-0104 R22). The provider has no audience: ADR-0094 R14 checks the aud of every Kubernetes token.

type.description: single: one issuer, given by issuer. The provider kubernetes accepts no other type.

jwksUri.description: The address of the keys, over https only (ADR-0094 R32). With jwksBearerTokenFile it is an in-cluster address (ADR-0104 R28).

jwksBearerTokenFile.description: The absolute path of the file whose token goes with each request for the keys (ADR-0104 R14, R24). At start the agent compares the iss of that token with issuer (ADR-0104 R29).

issuer.description: The iss of the tokens, compared byte for byte (ADR-0104 R19).

mode.description: matchAny: aud must hold one of values. ignore: the agent does not check aud, whether the token has one or not.

values.description: The values of aud that the mode matchAny accepts, compared byte for byte.

httpUrl.description: An address over http or https.

url.description: An absolute URL of printable ASCII characters, without a space, a fragment, {, or }.

realmTemplateUrl.description: Like url, except that it holds {realm} once, as one whole path segment.
